The finding still records that UCC-049 through UCC-106 were preserved tokens plus prose, with no types, requiredness or defaults. UCC-230 still requires every definition field to carry a type from the closed vocabulary, a required flag and a default. The stage-2 counterexample is no longer in the live text. F3-717 says CV-369 types the provider fields through NotificationDestinationProfileV1 and does not restate them. Destination create binds profile to Plans/Contracts_V0.md#CV-369/NotificationDestinationProfileV1, discriminated by the provider argument, required, default none. Destination update binds the same contract, discriminated by the stored destination's provider, not required, default none, and the section says an optional profile is a whole-profile replacement, never a field merge. The old profile block whose ref was Plans/Contracts_V0.md#CV-298 and whose required flag was true is absent from that section. CV-369's section holds the six closed records and the webhook predicate atoms. Slack credential_ref, Discord webhook_credential_ref, generic-webhook timeout, ntfy server_ref, the Pushover retry/expire policy object and Telegram bot_token_ref each state type, required and default, as do the predicate kind consts. resolve_ref resolves a Plans doc unit contract name only through ctx.typed_contracts and returns false when the contract is absent; the old bare PlanUnit membership return is absent from the function. Other F3-717 fields still marked provenance gap carry type, required and default, which is what the overlay requires, so they do not restore the untyped-profile defect. The repaired closure holds.
